genius.notes: Evidence reviewed 2026-10-07: GYEN is issued by GMO-Z.com Trust Company, Inc., a U.S. New York limited-purpose trust company identified in the NYDFS directory; GMO JPY is also named on the NYDFS issuance Greenlist. Those legacy state approvals do not establish GENIUS state qualification or PPSI approval. No token-specific public GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application or announced GENIUS route was located in the checked public sources. The issuer commenced voluntary wind-down and dissolution under New York Banking Law section 605 on May 15; minting ceased, while verified account holders may redeem 1 GYEN for 1 JPY through November 11, 2026. This issuer-initiated wind-down is not coded as a GENIUS enforcement action. The August 6 and August 31 reserves received an AICPA examination opinion from The Network Firm, signed September 9; monthly reserve assurance remains publicly present during wind-down. Generic website minting/redeem-anytime descriptions are superseded by the dated wind-down terms. Substantive federal rules remain proposed; not-yet-restricted is limited to GENIUS DASP implementation, not European restrictions or issuer mint cessation.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or announced GENIUS route was located for GYEN or GMO-Z.com Trust Company, Inc. in the opened regulator and issuer sources. The NYDFS directory establishes the legacy New York limited-purpose trust charter and named GMO JPY issuance approval, not GENIUS qualification. Voluntary wind-down does not by itself establish prohibited-or-revoked GENIUS enforcement status.
